checks.name: The shipped layer is a deterministic gzip with a zeroed mtime
Fourteen site records, two enhancements and four documented deferrals ship together
The review ledger accounts for every reviewed candidate exactly once
Every shipped record keeps its authored bilingual text, period and review checks
Periods never escape their verbatim source range and open ends are declared
UNESCO quotes, coordinates and property ids match their reviewed evidence
New city evidence snapshots, DMS conversion and activity periods remain independently verifiable
No attested record is merged into, or duplicates, an existing place record
Resolved nearby records carry recomputed distances that match the research file
Enhancement entries attach to real records without overwriting coordinates or observations
Deferred candidates keep their reasons and never appear as shipped points
Chinese text is simplified across the layer
Read semantics for the integration layer are shipped with the data
